description: The copy of the theme under `libs/components/themes` and the theme as `tokens:build` writes it both gain an `@media (orientation: portrait)` block, and 1.3.4 keeps resting on the scan. The copy is left out — it is there only after a library build and may be an earlier one's — and the theme is read as built, so the refusal names `libs/tokens/dist/pct.css`. A reader that took the copy names it first, the library being walked before the theme is read. Laid on disk and read by the live reader (`tree`).
